concept: Lambda cost: memory right-sizing + Compute Savings Plans
tests: How to cut Lambda cost with steady, predictable invocation volume while staying serverless.
expected: Right-size memory based on profiling (e.g., Lambda Power Tuning / Compute Optimizer) + a Compute Savings Plan, which covers Lambda. Triggers: "steady, predictable invocation volume", "keeping the serverless model".
why_not: Moving to On-Demand EC2 abandons serverless; max memory for all functions increases cost; disabling logs doesn't reduce compute cost.
